title_en: Clearing opportunity! At the "Aura" Complex, 2+1+2 Apartment for Sale, with Perfect Orientation and Layout!!!
description_en: Clearing opportunity! In "Aura" Complex, 2+1+2 Apartment For Sale, With Perfect Orientation And Layout!! The apartment with a total surface area of ​​121.5 is located in one of the buildings of the complex and is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchenette, two bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, one of which is in the master bedroom and a balcony. Its orientation is East. The complex is organized with two floors of underground parking, the ground floor is completely dedicated to business premises and 10 residential floors will be developed above. Some of the benefits of the complex are: facade covered with thermal insulation, capot system; double-glazed windows with gas filling for noise reduction and thermal insulation; acoustic insulation in the partitions between apartments; prepared central heating system. The inner courtyard is a space filled with benches and greenery, at the back of the complex, its north-eastern part.
